label: Album
definition: A release whose Apple title has no ' - Single' or ' - EP' suffix. Apple lists BTS's mini albums this way.

label: EP
definition: A release whose Apple title ends in ' - EP'.

label: Person
definition: Someone credited as writer, lyricist, composer or producer.

label: Recording
definition: One version of a song: original, live, remix, demo, Japanese and so on.

label: Single
definition: A release whose Apple title ends in ' - Single'.

label: Song
definition: A composition, across all its versions.

label: Track
definition: A song as listed on Spotify or Deezer.

label: Video
definition: A video of one song on BTS's YouTube channel.
